text.description_html:
First Impressions CF-3452 Contemporary Stainless Steel Appliance Pull

This all new curved pull flows outward, away from the appliance door. The center of the pull has approximately 4" of distance from the door and both ends of the pull approximately 1/2" distance.

This contemporary satin stainless steel appliance pull from First Impressions is packaged with mounting screws for a refrigerator / appliance door panel. The warm Satin Stainless Steel finish resist finger prints for easy maintenance.

Long lasting stainless steel pull with a very clean contemporary design. Nice sized 1" diameter pull is easy to grab to effectively pull open todays large "vacuum" sealed doors such as the ones found on a Sub Zero refrigerator.

Specifications for First Impressions CF-3452 Stainless Appliance Pull

  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1"
  • Bracket Diameter: 1"
  • Total Projection: 5"
  • Material: Stainless Steel Tubing
  • Satin Stainless Steel Finish

Available in 3 standard lengths.

  • FII-CF-3452/24-US32D: Total Length 24" - Center to Center Mount - 17"
  • FII-CF-3452/36-US32D: Total Length 36" - Center to Center Mount - 28-3/4"

    • Note: All dimensions including total lengths and center to center distance are approximate. This stainless steel appliance handle is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths up to 6 feet. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the appliance handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

    Packaged with mounting screws for a standard 3/4" thick refrigerator/appliance door panel.

    *Sold individually.
